convert_xywh_to_xyxy: convert a list of xywh bounding boxes to xyxy format using xywh_to_xyxy
convert_xyxy_to_xywh: convert a list of xyxy bounding boxes to xywh format using xyxy_to_xywh
compute_boxes_area: compute the area of an array of bounding boxes using boxes_area
apply_nms: apply classic greedy non-maximum suppression to detections using nms with a threshold
apply_bbox_transform: apply bounding box regression deltas to proposal boxes using bbox_transform
